description: This PHP source file defines a class `Contact` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketing`. The class extends a base controller and manages the marketing contact page in the admin panel of an OpenCart project. It includes methods for displaying the contact form (`index`) and sending messages (`send`), handling permissions, loading models and language resources, and constructing email messages for various recipient groups.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Controller class handling the marketing contact functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering the contact form and processing email broadcasts to customers and affiliates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language resources, sets page title and scripts, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads store and customer group data, and renders the contact form view with the assembled data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles form submission to send emails to various customer groups or affiliates, validates permissions, constructs email messages in HTML format, schedules email sending tasks, and supports pagination for batch processing.
